run.ground_truth: In video A, the chef mixes mayonnaise and water with the eggs before cooking, creating an emulsion. In video B, the chef uses only plain cracked eggs without any additional ingredients. Video A's mixture includes dairy fat from mayo and hydration from water, while video B maintains a pure egg base.
